test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the sentence that has NO spelling errors.

options.text: The doctor presribed some medicine to alleviate my parsistent cough, which has been boathering me for days.
The doctor precribed some medicine to aleviate my persistent cough, which has been bothering me for days.
The doctor prescribed some medicine to aleviate my parsistent cough, which has been boathering me for days.
The doctor prescribed some medicine to alleviate my persistent cough, which has been bothering me for days.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4' **i.e.** '​The doctor prescribed some medicine to alleviate my persistent cough, which has been bothering me for days.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let's check the options one by one:

__
 
• **In Option 1**, the erroneous spellings are **'presribed'** (the correct spelling is** 'Prescribed'**), **'parsistent'** ( the correct spelling is **'Persistent'**) and **'boathering'** (the correct spelling is **'bothering'**).
 
• **In Option 2,** the erroneous spellings are **'precribed'** (the correct spelling is** 'Prescribed'**) and **'aleviate'** (the correct spelling is** 'alleviate'**).
 
• **In Option 3,** the erroneous spellings are** 'aleviate' **(the correct spelling is **'alleviate'**), **'parsistent'** ( the correct spelling is** 'Persistent'**), and **'boathering'** (the correct spelling is **'bothering'**).
 
• **In Option 4**, there is **no spelling error.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: '​The doctor prescribed some medicine to alleviate my persistent cough, which has been bothering me for days.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's look at the meanings of the concerned words:

 
• **Prescribed** means advised and authorized. (निर्धारित)
 
• **Persistent** means lasting for a long time. (लंबे समय तक चलने वाला)
 
• **Alleviate** means making (suffering, deficiency, or a problem) less severe. (काम करना)
 
• **Bothering** means taking the trouble to do something. (परेशानी)

203:Tb82,

The correct answer is 'Option 2'
